verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal consultation and visa application services, not a software platform. A downloadable machine-readable API spec is outside this product category. The evidence shows no API product of any kind, and the probe for OpenAPI paths returned 404, so nothing makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
